body:
The retained-data generation→assessment→selection tutorial under this issue is delivered. The broader scientific/product work remains open; this completes the tutorial item only.

User page: `docs/content/user/hydramp_workflow.md`.
Maintained example: `examples/replay_hydramp_workflow.py`.
Verification record: `devguide/hydramp_workflow_tutorial.md`.
Evidence receipt: `devguide/evidence/hydramp_workflow_tutorial.json`,
SHA-256 **`e725169205b6c84e2de96bc7b93938c13bdfd3227395a2baa8a77f13030af25f`**.

The example uses only public `HydrAMPReceipt.from_json`, `ResultSet.from_json` and `select`, with reviewed original-file digests. It checks complete generation/assessment input identity, including occurrence order, source context and provenance. Its summary prints occurrence tokens/counts/exclusions/label observations and both full rankings, without copying peptide sequences or full trace payloads into a new fixture.

**Two actual saved-batch replays pass** against the unchanged installed consumer wheel `18b1cb18b9662092203aad9c64d45bc0d61a862577297c13a664572dbdbc3e83`. Each retains 16 proposals / 15 eligible / one exclusion. Both k=4 selected lists and complete rankings match the original H4 result summary exactly. Saved native labels retain nine AMP-positive occurrences among thirty eligible, zero joint AMP-positive/NonHemo hits.

**Three expected CLI rejections pass:** incorrect generation digest; mixed seed-1001 generation/seed-1002 assessment with correct file hashes; and newer public generation plus older private assessment despite identical sequence views. The last case protects against treating equal sequences as evidence of the same operation/provenance.

All five invocations use the exact installed consumer in isolated Python 3.14.10, CPU 0/1, one numerical thread, nice 10, 1 GiB virtual-address limit, 15 s per case. The guard blocks scientific/NumPy/Ackredit imports, scientific-array opens, unreviewed JSON and network. Original H4 file hashes match their original execution receipt. No model, PCA, descriptor, Macrel call or new scientific credit occurs.

Strict Sphinx HTML with warnings fatal and six existing model-free doctests pass; the example is literal-included, not executed, during the build. The reporting lifecycle guard passes with published Receptor 1.2.2 in the isolated Python 3.14.7 worker. Ruff, formatting, indexes, whitespace and 116 relative file links pass. All 22 package Python files remain identical to the wheel/source/both installed prefixes.

The page explains that H4 receipts require an **authorized local copy** and are not bundled downloads. The original private H4 and separately executed public generation case remain separate proofs; replay is not a new all-public live inference chain, efficacy benchmark or release. A future real generation/assessment still needs its exact finite resource/call approval. D41 and D35/M1–M8/selector meanings remain unchanged.

The active record is now partial with this delivered item recorded. HydrAMP #3–#6 and the remaining consumer follow-ups stay open. Source/doc changes remain local and uncommitted; no site/package/model publication, raw-sequence redistribution or original-author contact. Retain task resources through 2026-11-13.
